setup.description: Onboarding — locates/creates the Drive business root and the shared _business-memory folder, and collects required fields for every registered capability.

add-func.description: Adds a new capability to business-manager — registers it in modules.json and scaffolds its skill file.

write-email.description: Writes a single email for a specific purpose (outreach, nurture, announcement, follow-up, campaign step).

log.description: Captures a structured entry (client preference, campaign learning, positioning decision, etc.) into the shared _business-memory log for later recall.

add-log-field.description: Registers a new log field/category in the shared _business-memory log schema so future log entries can use it.

forget.description: Soft-deletes an entry from the _business-memory log (marks it forgotten rather than erasing it) when it's outdated, mistaken, or no longer relevant.
